relevance_note: The paper describes one in-scope person, a child with succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency ("A 7‐year‐old male patient with SSADH deficiency was scheduled for multiple extractions and restorations under general anesthesia"), and ties an ALDH5A1 variant to him.
method_note: Single-patient case report read in full by hand; no script was used to transcribe anything, and the paper contains no tables, so no stacked cells and no per-patient source column occur. Only one person is in scope: the 7-year-old boy with SSADH deficiency (label rule 5, "patient"). No relative is described with any individual-level detail ("Family history did not contribute"; the legal guardians appear only as consent givers), so no relative rows were made. No contradictions between statements were found. Uncertainties: (1) the header prints "Authors: Savaş Zülfü"; the surname cannot be told from the print order, so first_author was recorded as "Savaş" (header quoted verbatim as span). (2) The paper says the boy "was followed up for hypotonia and developmental delay during the infancy after birth", the only age-like onset statement, so age_at_onset was recorded as "infancy" (no number, ISO null). (3) For the checklist item "intellectual disability" the paper's own wording is "cognitively delayed", taken as observed. (4) The MRI finding is T2A/FLAIR hyperintense signal changes "in the white matter and subcortical areas at bilateral frontotemporoparietal levels", not in the globus pallidus, subthalamic or dentate nuclei, which the paper never mentions; that checklist item was left "not reported" and the finding was recorded as a phenotypic feature in the paper's own words. (5) Preoperative laboratory tests "were within normal limits" is a normal investigation as a whole naming no single abnormality, so it was not turned into an excluded feature. (6) The paper ties a homozygous ALDH5A1 variant to the patient but prints no variant description, so the variant row keeps variant_original_string = "not reported" (D-22). (7) Consanguinity is not reported although the variant is homozygous; zygosity "homozygous" comes from the patient's own sentence. (8) cohort_size_as_stated was set to 1 from "We present the case of a 7‐year‐old boy"; the authors give no explicit cohort number. (9) Some treatment spans are short fragments because the paper writes doses with a narrow no-break space between number and unit, which is hard to reproduce exactly.

study_type.span: This case report aims to contribute to the limited body of knowledge by detailing the anesthetic management of a SSADH‐deficient pediatric patient undergoing dental treatments under general anesthesia.

n_patients_reported.span: We present the case of a 7‐year‐old boy, who underwent dental procedures under general anesthesia, with genetically confirmed succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency.

treatment_summary.value: General anesthesia for dental extractions and restorations: low-dose midazolam 0.05 mg/kg; lidocaine 1 mg/kg, propofol 3 mg/kg, fentanyl 1 mcg/kg and rocuronium 0.75 mg/kg for intubation; maintenance with sevoflurane in a 50% air/oxygen mixture; ondansetron 0.2 mg/kg; local infiltration of 2% lidocaine with epinephrine; paracetamol 10 mg/kg and sugammadex 4 mg/kg at the end of the operation; no sedative premedication and no prophylactic anticonvulsants.
